brief:
Israeli occupation authorities compelled a Jerusalem resident to demolish his own house in Sur Baher, the Shehab Wire reported. Omar Ibrahim Omira was forced to destroy the structure himself after the municipal authority claimed it was built without a permit, despite the residence sheltering his wife and three children.

The self-demolition was carried out under threat of more costly Israeli enforcement action. Residents in occupied East Jerusalem frequently face such orders, which Palestinians view as part of a broader displacement policy in the territory.

title: Israeli municipality forces Jerusalem resident to demolish his own home
